result.summary: The environment is a high-density urban corridor with wide sidewalks and a marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection. The street is a multi-lane one-way thoroughfare, which can lead to higher vehicle speeds and longer crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with wide sidewalks and curb ramps featuring tactile warnings. However, there is a lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals for crossing the side street, and parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide sidewalks and signalized control, but lacks high-visibility crosswalk markings. The wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance, and parked vehicles near the intersection may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb may block the view of pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite the presence of traffic lights. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway creates a high-exposure environment for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, making pedestrian crossing points unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection
